name: bufatechno-webgamedev
description: BUFATECHNO WEB GAME DEV — skill for building complete, production-ready web games with Three.js (WebGPU/TSL) or Babylon.js (WebGPU/Havok). Optimized for ZCode and Claude. Covers scaffolding, ECS, PBR/IBL, WebGPU/TSL, VFX/particles/post-processing, Web Audio, assets (GLTF/Draco/KTX2/Splat), 2D canvas/sprites, and animation (mixer/skeletal/morph/blending). Use when user asks to create, build or ship
